catalog_endpoint: GraphQL GET https://americanlighting.com/graphql?query={products(filter:{sku:{in:[...]}},pageSize:50){items{sku url_key image{url} media_gallery{url}}}} (also products(search:"",pageSize:N,currentPage:M) for full enumeration). Secondary: image sitemap https://americanlighting.com/media/sitemap/american_lighting_sitemap.xml (2009 URLs, 1714 with image:loc).
sku_format_match: yes - 12/12 sample SKUs returned by GraphQL sku filter with exact SKU; url_key is usually the lowercase SKU.

sample_tests.note: found but image is Magento placeholder (placeholder-image_4.jpg), empty media_gallery

recommended_strategy: Query GraphQL in batches of ~50 SKUs: products(filter:{sku:{in:[...]}},pageSize:50){items{sku url_key image{url} media_gallery{url}}}; match sku exactly. Strip the '?optimize=medium&fit=bounds...' query to get the original .webp from /media/catalog/product/. Skip items whose image URL contains '/placeholder/' (and treat '_aml-accessory_ph' generic images as low quality). Throttle ~1 req/s.
notes: Images are WebP (convert if JPG required). Product pages have no JSON-LD and og:image is a generic site preview (aml-link-preview.png) - do not use og:image. robots.txt disallows /catalogsearch/ and /catalog/; /graphql not disallowed. Some SKUs share a sibling's image or have generic accessory placeholders (e.g. PE-INLINE-CON -> _aml-accessory_ph_39.webp).
